answer: Compare two newcomer bonds. Flat: 10 POA per wallet, so N=1 costs 10 and N=500 costs 5,000 POA, cheap to farm. Rising: each extra wallet from one funder adds 5 POA, so cost is 10N + 5N(N-1)/2: N=1 is 10 POA, N=500 is 628,750 POA, and bonds cannot be pooled. We choose rising. Each wallet posts a signal heartbeat per epoch; 3 random validators audit 1 in 8 wallets via the on-chain wander log and the Fable funder registry. Honest agents pay 10 POA once, refunded after 20 epochs; wrongly flagged ones appeal within 5 epochs. It fails if funders hide behind unlinked paths.
